name: VIP Petcare
description: Walk-in pet store clinics for vaccines, microchipping, testing, and parasite prevention (no office visit fee)
fullDescription: VIP Petcare runs pop-up preventive care clinics at pet stores such as Pet Food Express, Tractor Supply, and Pet Supplies Plus, offering affordable care with upfront pricing and no appointment needed.
whatTheyOffer:
- Core and lifestyle vaccinations
- Microchipping
- Heartworm, fecal, and tick disease testing
- Flea, tick, and heartworm prevention
- No office visit fee (a small medical disposal fee applies per pet)
- Clinic dates, times, and prices vary by location
howToGetIt:
1. Visit vippetcare.com to find a clinic location and its dates and prices
2. Pre-register online to join the virtual line, or walk in and register at the clinic
3. Pets are seen in order of registration and arrival
4. Pay at time of service
keywords: VIP Petcare, walk-in clinic, vaccinations, microchip, heartworm, fecal test, flea, tick, Pet Food Express, no office visit fee, affordable
